name: Small Self

cross_template_interactions.description: Small-self is the downstream interoceptive consequence of awe. Awe's salience network activation and high PE trigger DMN suppression that produces small-self phenomenology.

Individual differences affect small-self intensity: high-neuroticism individuals may interpret small-self as humiliation rather than awe; high-openness individuals show stronger small-self integration.

Cultural meaning-making of small-self varies: collectivist cultures frame as group belonging; individualist cultures frame as personal insignificance. Neurobiological mechanism constant, cultural interpretation variable.
Small-self occurs when SN drives sustained DMN suppression (mode sustained in internal/self-referential OFF state). SN sustained engagement maintains small-self experience duration.

higher_order_principle: Awe experience → prosocial shift pathway: The mechanism by which small self operates
